apify-actor-start.eventDescription: Synthetic platform event, charged by Apify itself once per GB of run memory, rounded up with a minimum of one (so always once per run at this Actor's 1,024 MB maximum); includes 5 compute seconds. Not charged by the Actor code.

job.eventDescription: One Lever posting (or, with discoverFilters, one filter record per site, not per posting) pushed to the dataset.
